scope: Read-only review of new native editable companion for normalized transport-arm architecture; not replacement or pixel review of manuscript Figure24.

semantic_checks.path: Normalized observed grids -> shared spatial encoder -> encoded support
semantic_checks.finding: Three normalized 4x4 grids; fixed encoded support E_-2:0, as in the anchored transport branch.

semantic_checks.path: Encoded patch means plus two normalized past action blocks -> TransitionContext -> FiLM
semantic_checks.finding: One support-only context fixed across horizons. Does not claim the original two-context factorization; no future action path enters this context.

semantic_checks.path: Past actions concatenated with causal future prefix -> unidirectional GRU -> select u_-1,u_0,u_h -> LeWM temporal predictor
semantic_checks.finding: Matches concatenated past/future GRU indices 0,1,t+2 and the three fixed FiLM-conditioned support states. No query image is depicted as a model input.

semantic_checks.path: H_h -> bias-free query; pre-FiLM E_0 -> bias-free key -> row-softmax
semantic_checks.finding: T_h = softmax_row(Q_h K_0^T / sqrt(96) + 4 I), with identity bias outside the scale division and normalization over source patches.

semantic_checks.path: Observed normalized Z_0 -> identity and T_h Z_0 branches
semantic_checks.finding: The anchor is the same actual last observation at every horizon. Mixing uses shared-channel standardized coordinates, not incompatible per-position normalizers.

semantic_checks.path: H_h -> sigmoid affine gate g_h; g_h -> mixed branch and 1-g_h -> identity branch
semantic_checks.finding: Correct scalar gate per target patch, including learned bias initially -3; complementary branches sum to a convex anchor mixture.

semantic_checks.path: H_h -> LayerNorm + affine residual projection -> tanh -> final addition
semantic_checks.finding: Innovation is componentwise bounded by 1 in the pinned transport arm. The result is normalized latent features, not physical flow, predicted RGB or a chosen action.
All five aliases have the correct canonical provenance; no extra independent input is introduced.
